name: The Comforter
overview: The Comforter, as revealed in Scripture, is both God Himself who comforts His people (Isaiah 51:12) and the Holy Spirit whom Jesus promised to send after His departure (John 14:16). This Comforter, also called the Spirit of truth, indwells believers, teaching them all things and reminding them of Jesus' words (John 14:17, 26). Jesus assures His followers that they will not be left as orphans but will receive this abiding presence who testifies of Christ and brings divine comfort and guidance (John 14:18, 15:26).
